§6Drawer Networks & Upgrades§f

§aGot drawers everywhere? Time to wire them together.§f

§9Shift + right-click§f a drawer with an empty hand to open its upgrade GUI. Each drawer has §e5 upgrade slots§f.

§6Storage Upgrades§f:
§b• Obsidian§f: §a2x§f capacity. §b• Iron§f: §a4x§f. §b• Gold§f: §a8x§f. §b• Diamond§f: §a16x§f. §b• Emerald§f: §a32x§f.
Stack multiple upgrades in one drawer for huge capacity. A single 1x1 drawer with a full set of Emerald-tier upgrades holds §e1,024 stacks§f.
§b• Void Upgrade§f: Destroys overflow once full. §cUse this on automated farms§f or your pipes will back up and lag.
§b• Conversion Upgrade§f: Merges ore dictionary variants from different mods into one slot.

§6Controller & Slaves§f:
A §bDrawer Controller§f links all adjacent drawers (including through §bTrims§f) within a §e12-block radius§f. Pipe items into the Controller and it sorts them to the right drawer automatically.
§bController Slaves§f give you extra I/O points on the same network, so you can run pipes in from multiple sides.

§6Drawer Key§f:
§9Right-click§f a drawer to lock its slot. Locked slots keep their item type even when empty, so random junk can't sneak in.

§ePS:§f One Controller, one pipe face, everything sorted. That's the dream.
